jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description_text: FireMon delivers Network Security Policy Control for the Modern Enterprise. Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together. We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments. As a Solutions Architect, you'll play a valuable role within the FireMon Customer Experience team, helping to assess business opportunities and support the development of strategies to address technical challenges. In this role, you'll work closely with security architects, infrastructure specialists, and engineering teams within customer organizations, gaining hands-on experience designing effective, results-driven solutions. You will support both Pre-Sale (Buyer's Journey) and Post-Sale (Customer Journey) phases, building your technical expertise and product knowledge along the way. With guidance from senior team members, you'll help empower customers to make informed decisions and achieve success in their projects.

Our platform spans many markets including the clinical, veterinary, and food safety industries. We are seeking self-motivated problem solvers who are excited to help decentralize traditional laboratory infrastructure. At the core of our company’s identity is a strong foundation in engineering. We take great pride in our commitment to critical thinking and pragmatic problem-solving through a modular and systemic perspective. We hold the conviction that transparent communication, coupled with the flexibility to adjust to evolving scenarios and the willingness to venture beyond familiar territories, is crucial to both our success and yours. jobs.description_text: About GeoComply We’re GeoComply! We are at the forefront of geolocation, cybersecurity, and anti-fraud innovation, developing and delivering cutting-edge technologies to help ensure regulatory compliance, combat bad online actors, alleviate user friction, and protect businesses from fraud. Achieving significant business and revenue growth over the past three years and dubbed a tech “Unicorn,” GeoComply has been trusted by leading global brands and regulators for over ten years. Our compliance-grade geolocation technology solutions are installed on over 400 million devices and analyze over 12 billion transactions a year. At the heart of it all is the people, united by a deep commitment to problem-solving and revolutionizing how people and businesses use the internet to instill confidence in every online interaction. With teams across five countries, three continents, and a global customer base, we have no plans to slow down. About the role The QA team in Vietnam tests anti-spoofing detection in the GeoComply Android and iOS SDKs. The work is to check whether the SDK detects the tools people use to fake a device’s location or to hide a rooted or jailbroken device. We are looking for an intern to take on this testing under the guidance of a mentor, to help automate its repetitive parts, and to support the team on its other tickets. jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Arlington, VA
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description_text: Build Your Accounting Experience Across a Broad Range of Financial Operations At Kitware, accounting goes beyond the general ledger. As our Accountant, you'll work across financial reporting, multistate tax compliance, and accounting processes while developing a broader understanding of how financial operations support an advanced research and development software company. This role offers a mix of independent responsibilities and collaborative work. You'll reconcile accounts, support accurate financial reporting, manage state and local tax filings, and help maintain accounting policies and procedures in a compliance-driven environment. You'll also build working knowledge of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Payroll, and Customer Cost Proposals, giving you exposure to several areas of the business beyond your primary accounting responsibilities. What You'll Do: Perform monthly account reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and support timely, accurate financial reporting. Prepare and file state and local tax filings, including sales and use tax, gross receipts tax, and other indirect taxes across multiple jurisdictions. Maintain tax filing calendars and supporting documentation to help ensure filing deadlines are met. Assist with documenting and updating accounting policies and procedures under management guidance to support compliance with GAAP and applicable government requirements. jobs.description_text: A Flexible, Part-Time Role Helping Keep Our Carrboro Office Running Smoothly Looking for a consistent part-time role with a flexible weekday schedule? As Kitware's Part-Time Office Assistant , you'll help keep our Carrboro office organized and running smoothly for employees, visitors, and collaborators. This position offers approximately 9-15 hours per week, typically 3-5 hours per day on three weekdays. You'll handle a variety of hands-on office responsibilities, from welcoming visitors and managing deliveries to maintaining shared spaces and helping with office events. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to general administrative projects and help support the day-to-day needs of our approximately 5,000-square-foot Carrboro office .

Kitware advances science and makes the world a better place through open-source software. Our leadership has a technical background, and there's no middle management layer between you and the problems you're solving. We're not chasing VC rounds or seeking an exit. We're building software that will matter for decades. jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo’s Commercial team is building the strategy, insights, brand and infrastructure required to bring LX2006 to patients – marking Lexeo’s transition from a clinical-stage to a commercial company. We are seeking an Associate Director, Marketing to play a central role in preparing for the launch of LX2006, Lexeo’s first commercial product, anticipated in the US in 2028 and globally thereafter. Reporting to the Senior Director, Marketing, this individual will serve as the LX2006 brand lead, owning critical launch workstreams end to end – from customer insights and competitive intelligence to market development, campaigns, customer targeting and launch readiness – and working closely with cross-functional partners in Market Access/HEOR, Medical Affairs, Patient Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Legal, CMC, and Business Development (ad hoc) as part of Lexeo’s Launch Readiness Team. The role will also support early commercial planning for LX2020, Lexeo’s gene therapy candidate for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. This is a highly visible, hands-on opportunity to build a launch from the ground up and help shape the commercial foundation of a growing clinical stage company. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE: Xsolla is an international IT company that offers a number of services for video games. Né du confinement et de l’atmosphère suffocante qui s’en dégageait, Le Média Positif souhaite faire ressortir le plus positif de l’actualité pour rompre avec le fatalisme et pousser à l’action. Aujourd’hui, nous rassemblons une communauté de plus de 11 millions d’abonnés sur l’ensemble des réseaux sociaux. Notre équipe est jeune, dynamique (moyenne d’âge : 26 ans) et portée par une vision ambitieuse : devenir le média de référence de la transition positive. Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.

Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.

Role

As a Senior 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI Engineer, you will own the development of the geometric and semantic perception stacks that power our physical AI framework. You will design real-time systems that enable our robots to translate unstructured, dynamic 3D environments into structured, queryable world models - seamlessly linking high-level task planners (such as VLM/VLA models) directly to robust, low-level manipulation and grasp policies in Flowstate. 

How your work moves the mission forward

  • Design and deploy real-time spatial perception and state estimation pipelines using both in-house models like Gemini/Gemma and open source models
  • Build multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating RGB-D, stereo cameras, and IMU
